failure_modes: A time-conditioned teacher/attention edit built on sign-conflicting observed-node contrasts (4-10 sign changes, 1-9 strong sign conflicts) would apply an unstable direction and unnecessarily displace surrounding coordinates via the positive surrounding regional weight, harming secondary strain/validity without a validated affinity gain.

Dose-only edits (native_rms_ratio) would change injection magnitude without any evidence of affinity benefit; the audit metrics are geometric teacher-proximity diagnostics, not the score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, so a larger or smaller dose is not defensibly better.

Treating last-record survival credit or geometric excess-distance enrichment as final affinity benefit would be a semantic error: lineage support is not terminal affinity, and no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, so any such edit would be unjustified.

Interpreting a temporal derivative as a spatial coordinate gradient would mis-specify the reward; the registered temporal recipe changes only regional attention at observed score nodes, not a velocity force.
rationale: D1.2: The registered alternatives split into a dose-only axis (native_rms_ratio C001-C003) and a time-conditioned axis (time_ramp_power C004-C006). The incumbent already sits at native_rms_ratio 0.33 (C002) and time_ramp_power 0.0 (C004), so the only genuinely new content is a time-conditioned teacher/attention recipe. The temporal evidence is observed-node linear interpolation with extrapolation disallowed, and the inspected landmark contrasts show 4-10 sign changes with 1-9 strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78 (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb, E598d52f84227fbcc, E1ba2a68ba5243c03). A sign-unstable contrast cannot be turned into a defensible time-conditioned teacher coordinate or regional-attention schedule, and the temporal_region recipe would change regional attention at observed score nodes rather than only dose. D4.1: Against the incumbent, the evidence provides no defensible expected advantage for any offered edit. The information audit states the geometric nearest-teacher metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and are not a causal affinity effect (E2bb8390452ed517a), and lineage support is last-record survival credit over 14 batches with sparse ancestry, explicitly not terminal affinity effects (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1). With the objective affinity-first and no decoded terminal affinity labels (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1, E0857891f4effbfe1), no offered parameter change is supported over the incumbent, so retaining is the evidence-consistent choice. D4.2: The predicted failure of a time-conditioned edit is that a sign-conflicting contrast would displace surrounding coordinates unnecessarily: the regional recipe adds positive surrounding Gaussian weight, so an unstable sign would push non-target coordinates away from their native positions without any validated affinity benefit, degrading the secondary strain/validity criteria while leaving the primary affinity objective unimproved. Because coordinate graph change alone is not a failure mechanism and no affinity evidence favors the edit, this prediction reinforces retaining the incumbent. No temperature edit is proposed; the fixed mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 are preserved.
